quote: At most two examples, and only names from this caller's own list.
rule: Multi-card selection question with at most two of the caller's own card names.

quote: If the caller already said a card name when they arrived and it fits exactly one card, skip the question and read that card.
rule: A card named on arrival skips the selection question.
defect: The flow always goes load_cards -> select_prep -> card_select and plays the selection question. Nothing reads a card name the caller gave on arrival.
fix: Before card_select, pass any arrival utterance or IVR intent variable to resolve_card. If it matches exactly one main card, set select_state=chosen and go to load_balance.

quote: “Son dört hanesi 4253 olan birden fazla kartınız var. Kartınızın son altı hanesini söyler misiniz?” (caller's own four digits in place of 4253)
rule: Same last four -> ask for the last six, with the four digits spoken one by one.
defect: The prompt puts ms[0]['l4'] in as raw numerals (e.g. '4253'), so TTS may say 'dört bin iki yüz elli üç'. The brief says last-four digits are said one by one, never 'kırk iki elli üç'.
fix: Build the digits with the DIG word list (' '.join(DIG[int(ch)] ...)), as load_balance already does.

quote: if it fits none, read all the names again, and that uses up one try
rule: Unknown name -> say there is no such card, read the eligible names, count a try.

quote: No product name from the service:** the card is introduced by its last four only
rule: Empty product name -> introduce the card by its last four only.

quote: | Nothing paid | `remainingMinPayment` > 0 and equal to or above `minPayment` |
rule: Three TL sentences chosen by remainingMinPayment vs minPayment; TL said as Türk Lirası.

quote: Phoning on the day the statement is cut: tell them the cut is today and happens at 00.00, then give the total debt.
rule: On statement day: say the cut happens at 00.00, then give the total debt.
defect: When nsd == today, the code adds the 00.00 sentence and then continues with the normal reading. It never says the total debt (debtTL.totalDebt) that this rule requires.
fix: In the nsd == today branch, add 'Gelecek dönemler dahil toplam borcunuz ' + cop(amount(tl_total,'TL')) + '.' after the cut sentence.

quote: A card so new that no statement has been cut yet: tell them there is no debt, and don't invent a date to go with it.
rule: No statement yet -> no debt, no date.

quote: Then, if the caller has another eligible card: “Başka bir kartınızın borcunu öğrenmek ister misiniz?” Yes → card selection. No, or no other card → main menu.
rule: NO_DEBT reading -> another-card question if applicable, otherwise main menu (no offer).
defect: reading_prep does not use the NO_DEBT status. A single-card NO_DEBT caller hears the offer as after_question. A multi-card caller who says no goes to after_no -> offer. The brief sends both to the main menu; the offer in this branch was 'not agreed yet'.
fix: Set a no_debt flag in load_balance. In reading_prep, when no_debt is set and no other card is left, make after_question empty and route a no or silence to end_menu. In after_no, go to end_menu instead of offer when no_debt is set.

quote: `contact.email.get` or `statement.pdf.send` fails (error, timeout, "document not found"): “Şu anda işleminizi gerçekleştiremiyorum, sizi müşteri temsilcimize aktarıyorum.”
rule: If the e-mail lookup fails, transfer to an agent with the service-error sentence.
defect: load_email always goes on to reading_prep. With has_email='error', reading_prep treats the caller as having no e-mail and offers only the week change. The caller goes to an agent only if they still ask for e-mail, so the failure is hidden.
fix: In reading_prep, when has_email=='error', offer neither or transfer. Simplest: route load_email to end_service_error after the reading has been spoken, or mark the e-mail option unavailable and go to the agent if it is asked for (as email_route already does).

quote: Debt and e-mail in the same breath: read the debt, then go straight into the e-mail step without the offer question
rule: Debt plus e-mail requested together -> skip the offer and go to email_confirm.
defect: Nothing captures an e-mail request made before or during the reading. The reading's on_enter always appends after_question (the offer).
fix: Capture the caller's opening intent (e.g. an extraction in card_select or an arrival intent variable). When it includes e-mail, set after_question empty and route from reading_prep straight to email_route.

quote: Ask: “Ekstrenizi … adresine göndermemi ister misiniz?” A short, readable address is read as it is. A long or messy one is shortened
rule: Read back the registered address (shortened if messy) and ask before sending.

quote: A no, or "that address isn't mine any more": nothing goes out. In the second case also tell them we can't change the address on this call.
rule: No -> main menu; not my address -> cannot change it here, main menu.

quote: Paper and text message aren't something this step does; say so and go to the main menu.
rule: Paper or SMS request -> say it is not possible and go to the main menu.
defect: In the task_message, paper or text message gets the 'only the most recent statement to the registered address' line and the question is asked again (email_answer=stay). Nothing routes to the main menu, so the caller loops until max_node_turns (5) sends them to end_tries with the wrong sentence.
fix: Add an email_answer value 'paper_sms' that routes to end_menu with a fixed sentence saying paper and SMS are not available in this step.

quote: Asked to send it again: fine, up to three times in one call, then “Sizi ana menüye yönlendiriyorum.”
rule: Resend allowed up to three times.
defect: After a successful send, the call ends right away in end_email_sent. A caller who asks for it again cannot be served, and no counter exists.
fix: After a successful send, go to a conversation node that says the success sentence, allow resends while a code-counted send_count < 3, then go to end_menu.

quote: Before the week question the assistant may say “Hesap kesim tarihinizi yılda bir kez değiştirebilirsiniz.”
rule: Optional once-a-year sentence; the current week and next dates are read, then 'değiştirmek ister misiniz?'.

quote: Joint statement (`relationType` main or linked): read both cards here: each card's last four and name, the payment week, the next closing date and next due date.
rule: Joint statement: read both cards' last four and name.
defect: The intro names the caller's card by product name only ('<name> kartınızın'), without its last four. Only the related card gets its last four.
fix: Add 'Sonu <sel_l4 as digit words> ile biten' before the caller's card name in week_intro when rel is M or C.

quote: Preview: `statement.week.decide` with the chosen week and the card's current `statementDay` from step 1.
rule: Preview via decide with new_week and stmt_day; the API fields match.

quote: Something hedged ("perhaps", "I suppose") is not a yes: ask once more, plainly, three tries in all, until we get a clear "evet".
rule: Only a clear evet confirms; hedged answers are counted in code, three tries.

quote: A caller who has used the right this year is not offered the change; if they ask anyway, the same sentence is how we explain why it can't be done.
rule: If the yearly right is used, explain with the once-a-year sentence (not a service error).
defect: Any non-OK answer from statement.week.change, including a refusal because the yearly right is used, goes to end_week_error and is reported as a system failure with an agent transfer.
fix: In week_change post_process, tell a refusal (2xx with a non-zero responseCode or a non-OK exitState) apart from transport errors. On a refusal, say 'Hesap kesim tarihinizi yılda bir kez değiştirebilirsiniz.' and go to end_menu.

quote: Three tries per question, whatever the question. When the third is gone: “Size şu anda yardımcı olamıyorum. Sizi ana menüye aktarıyorum.” A try is lost on a mumble, an answer to some other question, or a flat refusal to say.
rule: Three tries per question, counted in code; repeats are not tries.
defect: Mumbles and refusals are extracted as 'stay' and never reach a counting code node. The only limit is max_node_turns: 8 in card_select, 6 in reading, week_choose and week_confirm, 5 in email_confirm, 4 in offer and week_ask. These counts also include repeat requests. So the caller gets anywhere from 4 to 8 tries instead of 3, and a repeat request can use one up.
fix: Add a 'fail' extraction value (mumble, refusal, off-topic) separate from 'repeat'. Route 'fail' to a code node that increments a per-question counter and goes to end_tries at 3. Raise or remove max_node_turns so it acts only as a safety net.

quote: First and second silence: ask the question again, shorter. Third silence: “Sesinizi alamadığım için görüşmeyi sonlandırıyorum.” and the call is closed.
rule: Third silence -> fixed sentence and close the call (no main menu), counted in code.
defect: Silence is handled only by the system_prompt ('If the caller has been silent three times in a row ... call end_call'). The model counts the silences, speaks the sentence and calls end_call with message_mode none. No code counter or fixed terminal node exists.
fix: Use the inactivity monitor or a silence event to increment a silence_count variable in code. On the third silence, route to an end_call node with spoken_message 'Sesinizi alamadığım için görüşmeyi sonlandırıyorum.'

quote: Only if they are still complaining after the third one do we say "Sizi müşteri temsilcimize aktarıyorum." and transfer to an agent.
rule: Angry caller: up to three calming replies, then agent; never return insults.
defect: g_angry is a silent code node that returns to __previous__. It speaks no calming reply itself; the previous node's on_enter replays instead (e.g. the whole reading). Some nodes (week_ask) have on_enter_first_entry_only and say nothing. The count works (n > 3 -> agent), but the required calming reply is never produced.
fix: Make g_angry speak a fixed calming sentence (tts on_enter) before returning to __previous__, while keeping the code counter.

quote: A slow service: “Bilgilerinizi kontrol ediyorum.” and keep waiting.
rule: Say 'Bilgilerinizi kontrol ediyorum.' while waiting on a slow service.
defect: Every api_request node has on_enter silent. The waiting sentence is never spoken, and timeoutMs 20000 with maxRetries 0 is fixed without it.
fix: Set on_enter to tts 'Bilgilerinizi kontrol ediyorum.' on the api_request nodes (at least where the wait follows caller speech), or use a filler/slow-response message.

quote: The caller switches to another transaction partway through (their limit, say): leave what we were doing, “Sizi ana menüye yönlendiriyorum.”, and the main menu picks it up.
rule: Switching to another transaction -> go straight to the main menu.
defect: The g_out_of_scope intent also covers 'or wants another transaction'. A caller who explicitly switches transactions is asked the 'yardımcı olamıyorum ... ister misiniz?' question instead of being routed straight to the main menu.
fix: Split it out as a global g_switch_transaction (an explicit request to do another transaction) that goes straight to end_other_transaction.

quote: If the caller volunteers a PIN, a one-time code or the card's long number when we didn't ask: we don't use it and don't repeat it, and remind them we never ask for a password.
rule: Volunteered PIN, code or number: ignore it and remind the caller.

quote: A goodbye or a thank-you after the reading means "nothing else": “Sizi ana menüye yönlendiriyorum.”
rule: Goodbye or thanks -> main menu with the fixed sentence (a routed end, not a hang-up).
defect: Every conversation node has an end_call tool (message_mode none), with the instruction 'Call end_call only right after you said goodbye'. On a goodbye the model can say a goodbye in its own words and hang up. That skips the main-menu routing and the fixed sentence of end_menu.
fix: Remove the end_call tool from the conversation nodes. Map goodbye/thanks to the existing 'no' extraction values so they route to end_menu, which speaks 'Sizi ana menüye yönlendiriyorum.'
